Zoe P: Morning! First-week onboarding question — I'm rehearsing an external demo and my hosted key started returning 429s when I ramp to ~25 req/s. Which key should I be using for customer-facing demos? Also can we get a one-off hosted burst?

Marta (DevEx): Welcome Zoe! For customer-facing demos we prefer the sandbox key unless you need production-like latency/throughput. Sandbox is intended for dev/demo but has much smaller quotas. If you truly need hosted throughput we can file a temporary quota increase.

Zoe P: I need streaming with embeddings, and low latency. Sandbox gave some 429s during spike tests.

Liam (Infra): Streaming + embeddings supported in sandbox, but token and concurrency buckets are low. Also check whether your CI or VPN is sharing an egress IP — that often causes proxy-level 429s. Quick check: run a curl from your laptop off the corp VPN and compare to your CI runner:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-small\",\"input\":\"ping\"}'
```

If laptop succeeds and CI returns 429, it's probably an IP bucket.

Zoe P: If it's an IP bucket, can infra assign a temporary egress IP for the demo window?

Liam (Infra): We can sometimes allocate a short-lived egress IP (1-4 hours) for demos. If you need higher token throughput beyond isolation, request a hosted burst. When filing the ticket include project id, demo start/end times, peak QPS, streaming vs non-streaming, and whether you need an egress IP. Tag @infra.

Zoe P: Any recommended retry/backoff? My custom loop retried aggressively and made the situation worse.

Marta (DevEx): Use exponential backoff with jitter and cap total concurrent requests. Our SDKs implement retries by default — avoid synchronous tight retries on 429. See https://console.redwood.ai/docs/retries.

Zoe P: OK filed ticket #9999 with demo window and QPS. Also curious if anyone can grant a short-lived 'demo' hosted key that doesn't affect billing/project quotas?

Liam (Infra): We don't issue separate billing-free hosted keys, but we can grant a temporary quota bump to your existing project or spin up a dedicated short window. Include the billing project id in the ticket and whether the customer session is external.

infra-bot: Support ticket #9999 created by Zoe P — status: awaiting-review.

Zoe P: Thanks all — switching rehearsal to my laptop and lowering concurrency for tonight. Will update when infra responds. :thumbsup:
